## Complete Project Catalog & Case Studies

### 1. PromptForge — AI Prompt Engineering Platform
- **Category**: Developer Tool / AI SaaS

- **Outcome**: Production platform serving thousands of optimized prompts with 100% free access and zero hallucination guardrails across GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and Gemini workflows.

### 2. SV Music — High-Fidelity Music Player
- **Category**: Native Mobile App (Android)
- **Releases**: https://github.com/suman-verse/sv-music/releases/tag/v1
- **Client**: Suman Verse (Self-Built Product, 2026)
- **Technologies**: Android, Kotlin, ExoPlayer, Material You Monet, Offline Audio Engine
- **Architecture**: Asynchronous background audio decoding service with notification controls, SQLite Room persistence for playlist telemetry, and dynamic OS wallpaper color synchronization.
- **Outcome**: Ultra-low latency offline audio player featuring Time Machine listening telemetry and pure black OLED battery saver mode.

### 3. Desun Hospital — Healthcare Web Portal
- **Category**: Healthcare & Hospital Portal
- **Client**: Desun Hospital & Heart Institute (NABH & JCI Accredited, 2026)
- **Technologies**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Hospital REST APIs
- **Architecture**: Multi-faceted doctor and department availability search, OPD consultation appointment booking, emergency hotline integration, and robotic surgery showcase.
- **Outcome**: Streamlined patient appointment booking, reducing phone queue wait times by 40% and increasing online doctor search engagement across East India.

### 4. Aero Force — Tebex Webstore Gaming Template
